svg.title: Phase 38 Compiled Agency: Relational IW(2) ARC-AGI-3, 7-Fabric waiOS + HeteroMosaic, 0.10 bpw JouleBit-LUT6, and Deterministic Null Suite
svg.desc: Four-panel summary of Claims LA-49 through LA-52 and 90 six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 theorems (1454 Linux bwrap fleet): (A) Official 16-environment ARC-AGI-3 Relational Width-2 IW(2) + 6-bit Benes LUT6 spatial induction; (B) 7-fabric waiOS 256x128 ternary integer conformance (BLAKE3 a541323b..., Ed25519 receipts, row-77 fault halt) and HeteroMosaic-MoL cross-substrate scheduling; (C) 0.105 to 0.450 bpw JouleBit-LUT6 vs Samsung LittleBit-2 optimizing Joules-Per-Correct-Token (JpCT) on Jetson AGX Thor DC shunt and live Cortex-M55 DWT; and (D) 256-task SHA-256-pinned Deterministic Null Hypothesis (H0) and Scholar-Codifier rung-projection suite.
